title: Renew an individual contractor licence
summary: Learn how to renew your individual contractor licence online if you are a licensed builder or tradesperson in NSW.
intro:
Builders and tradespeople must be licensed to do building work in NSW. When you receive your renewal notice, you can renew your contractor licence online.

To find your licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: You must be a builder or tradesperson who needs to be licensed to do building work in NSW.
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice), or your full personal details

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to complete your application and payment.

faqs.q: Where can I find my licence number and details?
faqs.a: You can visit Verify NSW to find your licence number and details.

faqs.q: What happens if I miss the renewal deadline?
faqs.a: If you do not renew on time, you must apply to restore your licence in person at a service centre. If your licence has expired more than 3 months, you need to apply for a new licence, and you cannot trade until the new licence is issued.

faqs.q: How do I renew my individual contractor licence?
faqs.a: Select the 'Renew online' button, select 'Next', and follow the prompts to complete your application and payment.
